title: 阅读中的名词性从句
goal: 判断名词性从句的作用，并提取主句和从句表达的意思。

points.label: 判断名词性从句在句中的作用
提取主句与从句表达的完整意思

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 名词性从句可以作主语、宾语或表语。that 引出陈述的内容，whether 表示是否，what、how 等疑问词表示所问的东西或方式。

body.box:
The teacher knows that the room is open.
that the room is open 是 knows 的宾语从句。

body.p: 理解这类句子时，先看主句里是谁在知道、认为或询问，再看从句给出的内容。knows、thinks、asks 表达的关系不同。

cards.title: 主语从句与形式主语
rows: that 主语从句
That the room needs repair is clear to the staff, who have seen the damaged floor and the broken window there.
That the room needs repair 是主语，is clear 作判断。
whether 主语从句
Whether the road will reopen remains uncertain, so the drivers are checking the notices before they leave the village this morning.
Whether the road will reopen 是主语，表示道路是否重开。
疑问词主语从句
What the children need is a quiet place to read, and the school plans to make one available after the summer break.
What the children need 是主语，指孩子需要的东西。
疑问词主语从句
How the team will use the room depends on its size, which the manager will measure before making any further plans.
How the team will use the room 是主语，表示使用方式。
形式主语 it
It is important that every visitor signs the book, because the staff use the record to prepare for the next event.
it 是形式主语，真正的主语是 that 从句。
形式主语 it
It remains unclear whether the bus will stop here, and the passengers are waiting for a notice from the local office.
it 是形式主语，真正的主语是 whether 从句。

cards.title: 宾语从句与表语从句
rows: that 宾语从句
The guide believes that the path is safe, but the visitors should still wear suitable shoes during their walk through the park.
that 从句作 believes 的宾语，是导游相信的内容。
whether 宾语从句
The manager asked whether the room was free, and the staff checked the calendar before they gave her an answer that morning.
whether 从句作 asked 的宾语，表示询问是否有空房。
疑问词宾语从句
The teacher explained how the students could use the dictionary, and the class then practiced looking up unfamiliar words in pairs.
how 从句作 explained 的宾语，表示使用方式。
疑问词宾语从句
The visitors learned where the bus would stop, so they waited near the main entrance until the driver arrived that afternoon.
where 从句作 learned 的宾语，表示停车地点。
that 表语从句
The good news is that the library will reopen, and the staff are arranging the books before readers return next week.
that 从句作表语，说明好消息的内容。
whether 表语从句
The question is whether the team can finish today, because the room must be ready for another group tomorrow morning.
whether 从句作表语，说明问题是能否在今天完成。
疑问词表语从句
The issue is how the school will share the space, since several classes need the same room on different days each week.
how 从句作表语，说明问题是怎样分配空间。
疑问词表语从句
The difficulty is where the group can store its equipment, because the small room is already full of chairs and tables.
where 从句作表语，说明困难是设备放在哪里。

body.box:
The editor thinks that the report needs a clearer title.
What does the editor think?
1. The title needs to be clearer.
2. The editor needs a new report.
3. The report needs a new editor.
4. The title is already clearer.

body.p: thinks 的主语是 editor，that 从句是编辑所想的内容：报告需要更清楚的标题。第一项说的就是这一点。

groups.text: The guide knows that the bridge is closed.

options: The bridge is closed.
The guide closed the bridge.
The bridge will soon reopen.
The guide wants the bridge closed.
items.why: that 从句是 knows 的宾语，内容是桥已关闭。

groups.text: Whether the road is open remains uncertain.

items.stem: What is the role of the whether clause?
options: It modifies the road.
It is the subject.
It is the object of remains.
It is the complement of remains.
items.why: whether 从句位于 remains 之前，作主语。

groups.text: The question is how the team will travel.

options: The team's past journey
The team's reason for travelling
The team's means of travel
Whether the team will travel
items.why: how 从句是表语，说明问题涉及出行方式。

groups.text: It is clear that the shop has closed.

items.stem: What is the role of it?
options: It names the shop.
It names the closure.
It refers to an earlier sentence.
It is a formal subject.
items.why: it 是形式主语，that 从句给出被判断的事实。

groups.text: The chairperson believes that the hall is large enough. The remaining question is whether the hall is available on Friday.

options: The hall is available on Friday.
The hall has sufficient space.
The meeting will end on Friday.
The hall is too small for them.
items.why: believes 后的 that 从句表示大厅足够大。

items.stem: What is the role of the whether clause?
options: It is the subject of is.
It modifies the remaining question.
It is the object of believes.
It is the complement after is.
items.why: whether 从句位于系动词 is 后，作表语。

groups.text: What the group needs is a larger table.

items.stem: What is the role of the what clause?
options: It is the subject.
It is the complement after is.
It modifies the table.
It is the object of needs.
items.why: What the group needs 作主语，is 后的短语作表语。

groups.text: The worker asked where the boxes should go.

items.stem: What did the worker ask about?
options: The person who should move the boxes
The time when the boxes should go
The destination of the boxes
Whether the boxes should be moved
items.why: where 从句说明工人询问箱子应放在哪里。

groups.text: The cook believes that the soup needs more salt, while the guests are still waiting at the table for their meal.

options: The guests want saltier soup.
The soup needs additional salt.
The meal has already been served.
The soup is ready to be served.
items.why: believes 后的 that 从句说明汤需要更多盐。

groups.text: Whether the shop will open on Sunday remains uncertain, so the customers have been advised to check the notice before visiting.

items.stem: What is the role of the whether clause?
options: It is the subject of remains.
It is the object of visiting.
It modifies the customers.
It is the complement of remains.
items.why: Whether 从句作 remains 的主语，表示周日是否开店。

groups.text: The teacher asked where the children had left the books, and the children pointed to a shelf near the classroom door.

items.stem: What did the teacher ask about?
options: The children who had taken the books
The time when the books were left
The place where the books were left
Whether the children had read the books
items.why: where 从句说明老师询问书的存放地点。

groups.text: The problem is that the room has no windows, although it has enough space for the whole group to meet there.

items.stem: What is the role of the that clause?
options: It modifies the word problem.
It is the subject of has.
It is the object of meet.
It is the complement after is.
items.why: that 从句位于 is 后，作表语，说明问题内容。

groups.text: It is surprising that the bus arrived early, since the road was busy and the passengers expected a much longer journey.

options: That the road was always empty
That the bus arrived ahead of time
That the passengers expected a long trip
That the journey was expected to be short
items.why: it 是形式主语；that 从句说明令人惊讶的事是车早到。

groups.text: What the visitors want is a map of the garden, which the staff can provide at the desk beside the entrance.

items.stem: What is the role of the what clause?
options: It is the subject of is.
It modifies the garden.
It is the object of provide.
It is the complement after is.
items.why: What the visitors want 是主语，is 后给出所需之物。

groups.text: The manager asked whether the chairs had arrived, but the workers had not yet checked the delivery at the back door.

options: Where the chairs had been delivered
When the chairs were going to arrive
Whether the chairs were already there
Whether the workers had checked the delivery
items.why: asked 的宾语从句以 whether 引导，询问椅子是否到达。

groups.text: The question is how the team can share the work, and the members will discuss that question at their next meeting.

items.stem: What is the role of the how clause?
options: It describes the next meeting.
It is the subject of discuss.
It modifies the team members.
It is the complement after is.
items.why: how 从句位于系动词 is 后，作表语，说明问题的内容。
